title: Update pdf-generator.tsx — encode content hash in QR URL and save to DB
acceptance_criteria: Import computeHash and getQuotationCanonicalData / getInvoiceCanonicalData from document-hash.ts
In generateQuotationPDFReact: before QR generation, call getQuotationCanonicalData + computeHash to get sha256_hex
In generateInvoicePDFReact: before QR generation, call getInvoiceCanonicalData + computeHash to get sha256_hex
After hash computed, save to DB: supabaseAdmin.from('quotations').update({ content_hash: hash }).eq('id', data.id)
After hash computed for invoice, save to DB: supabaseAdmin.from('invoices').update({ content_hash: hash }).eq('id', data.id)
DB save wrapped in try/catch — hash update failure should not block PDF generation
Import supabaseAdmin from @/lib/supabase-admin for server-side DB writes
Existing QR rendering code preserved — only URL encoding changes
Backward compatible: QR without hash still shows old URL format
Surgical edits only — change only QR URL generation lines and add hash computation block
completion_summary: Added hash computation to QR URLs using document-hash, DB save via createClient on download, surgical edits to invoice and quotation QR blocks
